Metadata.Title: The Last of Us Remastered
Metadata.Name: Remove 2-second frame time assert
Metadata.Note: WaitOnContextDone (ndgi-orbis-device.cpp:2209) halts the game via int 0x41 if a frame takes over 2.00 seconds. NOPs the ja into the halt block so the wait loop keeps spinning until the frame completes; its normal completion exit is unchanged.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004
